key_insight: GRC frames learning as recursively closing residuals, separating capability-preserving transformation from representation revision to achieve stability-plasticity compatibility.
engineering_relevance: For adaptive constitutive modeling and control, it offers a principled update rule that preserves prior responsibilities while safely improving response to new conditions.
method: Defines a complete representation-relation view at the learner-world boundary.
Derives a local tangent decomposition and a criterion for when representation revision is required.
Solves an affine constrained quadratic update with a necessary-and-sufficient stability-plasticity condition and a unique safe response.
evidence_signal: The paper is primarily theoretical, deriving compatibility conditions, uniqueness results, and closure/viability theorems rather than reporting a dataset or benchmark evaluation.
watch_item: The framework depends on regularity assumptions, fixed boundary representations, and affine-case derivations, so practical deployment may require careful approximation and validation.
paper_title: Generalized Residual Closure: General Learning Dynamics for Stability-Plasticity Compatibility
